statusLine.command: input=$(cat); j() { echo "$input" | jq -r "$1 // empty"; }; out=""; add() { [ -n "$1" ] && out="${out:+$out | }$1"; }; pct() { [ -n "$2" ] && add "$1:$(printf '%.0f' "$2")%"; }; model=$(j .model.display_name); dir=$(j .workspace.current_dir); wt=$(j '.workspace.git_worktree // .worktree.name'); adv=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '(.advisor | if type=="object" then (.display_name // .model // .id // .name) else . end) // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$adv" ] && adv=$(jq -r '.advisorModel // empty' "$HOME/.claude/settings.json" 2>/dev/null); ctx=$(j .context_window.used_percentage); h5=$(j .rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage); d7=$(j .rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage); br=""; [ -n "$dir" ] && br=$(git -C "$dir" --no-optional-locks symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git -C "$dir" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); add "$model"; [ -n "$adv" ] && add "adv:$adv"; pct ctx "$ctx"; pct 5h "$h5"; pct 7d "$d7"; [ -n "$dir" ] && add "$(basename "$dir")"; [ -n "$wt" ] && add "wt:$wt"; add "$br"; echo "$out"
